speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for presenting. You mentioned delayed menarche, unusual physical features, and a history of bone fragility; could you describe in detail the specific physical features you are noticing and any family history of similar symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 16-year-old female. The patient has not experienced menarche. She was noted to have partial labial fusion and clitoromegaly at birth. The patient's mother reports that during pregnancy she had abnormal hair growth on her chin. The patient has a history of severe acne and has sustained fractures following minor trauma. She is currently on oral isotretinoin and an oral contraceptive.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (specifically 21-hydroxylase deficiency).

The combination of ambiguous genitalia at birth (clitoromegaly, labial fusion), severe acne, hirsutism in the mother, and bone fragility due to chronic cortisol deficiency strongly points to this diagnosis. I will now request the appropriate genetic and hormonal tests to confirm this.
